quality_note: NISAR GCOV browse PNG is a visual preview (not quantitative backscatter). Underlying granule is from the NISAR Provisional collection (CRID P05023). Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
note: Same-day comparison (2026-10-20) over The Fens and The Wash (Lincolnshire/Cambridgeshire, UK). Optical view is 98% obscured by cloud cover, whereas NISAR L-band SAR penetrates clouds to reveal the coastline of The Wash, drainage networks, and agricultural fields.
